concepts.gloss_en: Regalim — plural 'feet/legs', used homiletically for the pilgrimage festivals (בחינת בינה) and for raglin=speech/the rebukers (מוכיחים)
Regel — singular 'foot', used homiletically for slander/strife (נרגן מפריד אלוף) and for counsel/advice (עצה, 'ברגליך' = following your counsel)

members.note: representative; singular, distinct sense (slander/counsel) and number from רגלים

notes: Singular vs plural carry different homiletic senses (regel=slander/counsel; regalim=festivals/speech/rebukers). Per rule 4 (different heads/number) and under-merge preference, kept as two separate concepts.
